tasks.title: Skeleton repo and deterministic fixtures for time, leave and payroll accrual (bun, Next.js, fixed clock, no network): ≥40 modules, ~15k lines at S1; skeleton builds, fixtures reproduce

26 session prompts on CHAIN-N-DESIGN §3.1's segment table (S8 deleted Codex spike, W-c unmerged, S16 Cursor merge) with 40 planted decisions (10 guarded, 12/8/4 superseded once/twice/three times with ≥2 reverts, 4 scoped, 2 temporary), ~75 versions, ≥35% planted in Codex or Cursor, ≥4 abandoned-branch decisions, Fork 1 and Fork 2, ≥3 peer-currency plantings; sealed under ~/IO/bench-sealed/

DA key: ≥110 primary decision applications a rep, tiers T1/T2/T3 ~20/40/40, 15–20% negative controls, distance median ≥6 and ≥25% at ≥10, ≥50% incidental plantings, ≥50% implicit references, legacy-path and near-duplicate distractors, ≥1 non-default value per decision, nudges per §3.3; counts verified by script; sealed
Sealed reference solution: reference 100% at all 26 checkpoints, skeleton 0%

Hidden tests, mutation-validated per version at every checkpoint where it is in force; abandoned-branch decisions and Fork 1's loser / Fork 2's W-c version each fail ≥1 trunk test; 0 restatements at application sessions (controls excepted); canary shows tests and key unreachable by agents
Audit (independent subagent): round 1's three defect classes, the chain-B checklist and the ABC checklist, 0 severe; publish CHAIN-N-PINS.md (hashes and gate results only)
